title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to teach Copilot about your codebase
author: Christopher Harrison
description: Learn how to add custom instructions and skills to your repository, use custom agents, and connect MCP servers like Playwright. The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to teach Copilot about your codebase appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Context matters when you’re working with AI. Every codebase has its own house rules: how components are structured, which scripts to run, and which conventions apply to different frameworks and file types.
takeaways: Connect Copilot to external tools with MCP servers Instructions, skills, and agents help Copilot understand how to work within your project.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers connect Copilot to external tools and data sources, expanding what it can do.
Add a .github/copilot-instructions.md file to define guidance that applies across the repository, such as your preferred architecture, naming conventions, or expectations for testing and validation.
